mapper.select: SELECT id, name, enabled, channel_codes AS channelCodes, scope_type AS scopeType, scope_values AS scopeValues, threshold_count AS thresholdCount, threshold_window_sec AS thresholdWindowSec, stay_open_duration_sec AS stayOpenDurationSec, cooldown_sec AS cooldownSec, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM door_swipe_rule_config WHERE enabled = 1

SELECT id, name, enabled, channel_codes AS channelCodes, scope_type AS scopeType, scope_values AS scopeValues, threshold_count AS thresholdCount, threshold_window_sec AS thresholdWindowSec, stay_open_duration_sec AS stayOpenDurationSec, cooldown_sec AS cooldownSec, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM door_swipe_rule_config ORDER BY enabled DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, name, enabled, channel_codes AS channelCodes, scope_type AS scopeType, scope_values AS scopeValues, threshold_count AS thresholdCount, threshold_window_sec AS thresholdWindowSec, stay_open_duration_sec AS stayOpenDurationSec, cooldown_sec AS cooldownSec, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM door_swipe_rule_config WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO door_swipe_rule_config (name, enabled, channel_codes, scope_type, scope_values, threshold_count, threshold_window_sec, stay_open_duration_sec, cooldown_sec) VALUES (#{name}, #{enabled}, #{channelCodes}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValues}, #{thresholdCount}, #{thresholdWindowSec}, #{stayOpenDurationSec}, #{cooldownSec})
mapper.update: UPDATE door_swipe_rule_config SET name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, channel_codes = #{channelCodes}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, scope_values = #{scopeValues}, threshold_count = #{thresholdCount}, threshold_window_sec = #{thresholdWindowSec}, stay_open_duration_sec = #{stayOpenDurationSec}, cooldown_sec = #{cooldownSec} WHERE id = #{id}
